people.name: Micaiah
people.line: A prophet who foretold King Ahab's death.

translations.web: Micaiah said, “As Yahweh lives, what Yahweh says to me, that I will speak.”
translations.bsb: But Micaiah said, “As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever the LORD tells me.”
translations.kjv: And Micaiah said, As the LORD liveth, what the LORD saith unto me, that will I speak.
translations.asv: And Micaiah said, As Jehovah liveth, what Jehovah saith unto me, that will I speak.
